title: Cheque QR Codes & Modern Automation: iCsekk

sections.content:
Today, nearly all Hungarian yellow cheques feature a **QR-kód**. Learners can pay either:
1. At the postal counter in person
2. At a postal cheque payment automated kiosk (*csekkbefizető automata*)
3. Via the mobile app *iCsekk* by scanning the QR-code with a smartphone.

items.spanish: A csekken lévő QR-kódot be tudja olvasni a telefonjával is.
items.english: You can also scan the QR-code on the cheque with your phone.

items.spanish: A csekkbefizető automatánál gyorsabban végezhet, mert nincs sor.
items.english: At the cheque payment kiosk you can finish faster because there is no queue.

items.spanish: A gép azonnal kinyomtatja a bizonylatot a sikeres tranzakcióról.
items.english: The machine immediately prints out the receipt for the successful transaction.
